candidate_evidence.quote: evaluating renal function in patients with severe anti-GBM disease comparing imlifidase and standard of care (SoC) with SoC alone

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Cmax = Maximum observed plasma concentration of imlifidase following dosing.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Imlifidase cleaves IgG. PD of imlifidase will be assessed as IgG levels in serum.

role_evidence.quote: Imlifidase is an immunoglobulin G (IgG)-degrading enzyme of Streptococcus pyogenes that is highly selective towards IgG.

agents.drug_class_hint: IgG-degrading bacterial enzyme (anti-GBM disease, not an antitumour agent)

role_evidence.quote: SoC consists of a combination of plasma exchange (PLEX), cyclophosphamide (CYC), and glucocorticoids.
SoC consists of a combination of plasma exchange (PLEX), cyclophosphamide (CYC), and glucocorticoids.

coder_notes: Anti-GBM here means anti-glomerular basement membrane disease (Goodpasture); fails S5. Imlifidase is given the experimental role only as the trial's investigational drug; it is not an antitumour agent, hence has_eligible_candidate false. Target engagement coded yes because a PD profile (IgG) is planned for imlifidase, but this is a non-oncology disease.
